text:
laura: Quick UX/a11y poke: in Org settings the invite row reads: Project name -> Role chip -> Invite CTA. Keyboard users expect primary action earlier. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.local/ux/invite-row-compact-2026.png :mag:
ben: I ran a quick NVDA pass. It announces "Project X, Developer role" then you have to press Tab twice to hit Invite. Feels like the action is buried.
aya: We should prioritize DOM order: heading -> invite -> role -> kebab. Visual layout can stay the same via CSS grid. Avoid tabindex hacks.
laura: Agree. Also a copy nit: change invite aria-label to "Invite people to Project X" so SR users get context.
ben: Also when SSO is toggled on in org header, invite behavior changes. We need an inline SR hint that updates politely: "SSO enforced 0 invitations restricted to org members" using aria-live=polite so screen reader users know immediately.
aya: For the role chip, current SR label is long: "Role: Developer - editable". Simplify to "Developer role". Keep an sr-only sentence for editable state only when relevant.
laura: Accessibility checklist proposal:
1) DOM order: heading -> invite -> role -> kebab
2) invite aria-label includes project name
3) role chip aria-label concise
4) kebab last in tab order
5) announce SSO toggle changes via aria-live polite
6) ensure focus rings preserved and chevrons remain touch-friendly
dev-qa-bot: QA tasks added: INV-1223 reorder DOM and preserve e2e selectors; INV-1224 add aria-live region for SSO state; INV-1225 contrast check for interactive role chip.
ben: Small implementation note: reordering DOM may affect CSS animations and focus-visible offsets. Please run storybook snapshots and update any tests relying on DOM index.
aya: I'll prototype the component change. Suggest adding aria-describedby on Invite when a default role will be applied: sr text like "Invite 1 assigns 'Viewer' role". Use straight quotes.
laura: Copy approves the aria-label and sr-only phrasing. Also request we avoid duplicating hidden buttons for SR only.
ben: Once prototype is up, I'll record a short VoiceOver/NVDA before/after audio clip for design review.
aria-bot: Reminders: 1) keep DOM logical order, 2) avoid tabindex except for exceptions, 3) use aria-live polite for toggles, 4) run axe and manual NVDA/VoiceOver checks.
laura: Targeting beta this sprint. @aya please tag me when PR is ready so we can include demos in the design review. :rocket:
